description.narrative: The initiative proposes to work to reduce food waste and loss and aims to stimulate the adoption of coordinated policies through the involvement of local communities by promoting dialogue between institutions and local actors to effectively address food waste challenges. Through this project, Italy aspires to manage and strengthen its leadership in the global agrifood sector, facilitating the exchange of best practices and contributing to sustainability and economic development in priority international contexts.
